How it works

Five steps, one person

The same counsellor stays with your case the whole way, so nothing has to be explained twice.

  1. Tell us where you're at

    Your goals, your budget, your academic background, and when you want to start.

  2. Shortlist your course

    Options weighed against entry requirements, cost and what you want to do afterwards. You choose — we don't place you with a preferred provider.

  3. Secure your offer

    We apply on your behalf and handle the back-and-forth with the institution until your offer letter and Confirmation of Enrolment are issued.

  4. Get your documents in order

    Transcripts, references, financial evidence and forms gathered and checked in advance, so nothing is missing at the point it matters.

  5. Settle in once you land

    Enrolment confirmation, bank account and Medicare setup, and help changing course if your plans shift.
